mentions.name: Sendery
mentions.description: Product teams at scaling companies who manage transactional product emails across developers, marketing, and ops, including multilingual content.
mentions.problem: Managing product emails as companies scale is time-consuming: keeping track of hundreds of templates, maintaining consistent designs, coordinating changes between developers and marketing/ops, and handling multiple languages.
mentions.audience: A transactional email platform for product teams that helps companies scale their product emails by tracking hundreds of templates, maintaining consistent designs, coordinating changes between developers and marketing/ops, and managing content across multiple languages.
mentions.source_excerpt: A small team and I are working on Sendery [1], a transactional email platform for product teams.
mentions.author: ncaroyannis
